title: Video Viewer
text: Display images or video frames, 4 inputs, no direct feedthrough, {Colormap} sets colormap; {Open at Start of Simulation} sets the open video viewer window at start, {Separate Color Signals} enables separate R, G, and B color channels, {One Multi-Dimensional Signal} enables one multi-dimensional signal, {Display the full path} displays full path of source data in the title, {Open new Image Viewer window for each export}, {Specify range of displayed pixel values [-Inf to Inf]} sets the range of intensity value to display, {Min}, {Max} and {Drop Frames to Improve Performance} sets the drop frame rate of input video signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: Input image or video matrix | array

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red color component of image or video matrix | array

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green color component of image or video matrix | array

params.name: Open at Start of Simulation
params.values: Open video viewer window at start of simulation on (default) | off

params.values: Enable separate R, G, and B color channels as input off (default) | on

params.name: One Multi-Dimensional Signal
params.values: Enable one multi-dimensional signal as input on (default) | off

params.values: Display full path of source data in the title bar off (default) | on

params.name: Colormap
